description: Selected-files retrieval (RFC V3.1 §17): each query runs against a selection of documents from a corpus where unselected documents often answer it better. The corpus is the retrieval eval's Markdown documents plus one fixture of every shipped non-Markdown format (backend/tests/fixtures/formats), ingested through the real path. Leakage is the share of retrieved chunks from outside the selection, and must be exactly 0. Grades are within the selection: 2 answers the query, 1 is related. A query with no grade-2 document measures leakage only. Queries with `passage_anchors` need more than one passage from one selected file: each anchor is verbatim text, and a passage counts as recalled when a returned chunk overlaps it. That is what the per-document hit cap can change, so it is measured with the cap and with one hit per file.
